durability_policy.committed: Everything under evidence/performance/spike-2/ is committed and is the durable record. It is small on purpose: corpus manifests, campaign metadata, summaries, oracle verdicts, the long-session trace, and the report.
durability_policy.ignored-local-scratch: The raw observation streams (JSONL), the per-job parse traces and the generated corpora live under the gitignored .pms-bench/ tree, on the SAME physical volume as the repository. They are NOT an archive and NOT durable. Each is listed below with its size and sha256 so a later run can prove whether it is looking at the same bytes; what survives them is the committed evidence.

correctness.name: oracle-c100.json
correctness.note: the incremental-vs-fresh-rebuild differential verdict, per revision
